title: The Design and Evaluation of an Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm in Autonomous Vehicles with Drivers' Subjective Feelings Considered
reasoning: The paper explicitly aims to incorporate and evaluate 'drivers' subjective feelings,' 'occupants' subjective level of comfort,' and 'trust' in autonomous vehicle algorithms. It uses a subjective evaluation questionnaire and models driver confidence and psychological stress, which are direct evaluations of human psychological well-being and trust, central to ethical considerations in autonomous systems.
